Message.Name: Sequence Number Reset Message
Message.Description: Sent to reset the Message Sequence Number at start of day, or in response to failure recoveries.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID for this NYSE feed listed in the feed's client specification.

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel over which the packet was sent.

Message.Name: Source Time Reference Message
Message.Description: Sent at the start of every second during periods of active data publication.

Field.Name: ID
Field.Description: ID of the originating Matching Engine partition to which this message applies.

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: Reserved for future use. Ignore any content.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Message.Name: Symbol Index Mapping Message
Message.Description: Published over the real-time data channels at system startup or in the context of a refresh sequence. Provides referential data for a single specified symbol or underlying symbol.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this symbol for all products within this market.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Null-terminated ASCII symbol in NYSE Symbology.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Market ID
Field.Description: ID of the Originating Market.

Field.Name: System ID
Field.Description: ID of the Originating matching engine server.

Field.Name: Exchange Code
Field.Description: For listed equity markets, the market where this symbol is listed.

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: Specifies placement of the decimal point in price fields for this security.

Field.Name: Security Type
Field.Description: Type of Security used by Pillar markets.

Field.Name: Lot Size
Field.Description: Round lot size in shares.

Field.Name: PrevClosePrice
Field.Description: The previous day's closing price for this security.

Field.Name: PrevCloseVolume
Field.Description: The previous day's closing volume for the security.

Field.Name: Price Resolution
Field.Description: Price resolution.

Field.Name: Round Lot
Field.Description: Round Lots Accepted.

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Reserved 2
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Reserved 3
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Message.Name: Symbol Clear Message
Message.Description: In case of a failure and recovery, the publisher may send a full state refresh for every symbol or series affected, preceded by a Symbol Clear message.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this symbol or series for all products within this market.

Field.Name: NextSourceSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number in the next message for this symbol

Message.Name: Security Status Message
Message.Description: Informs clients of changes in the status of a specific security or underlying symbol, such as Trading Halts, Short Sale Restriction state changes, etc.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this symbol for all products within this market.

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The unique ID of this message in the sequence of messages published for this specific symbol.

Field.Name: Security Status
Field.Description: The new status that this security is transitioning to.

Field.Name: Halt Condition
Field.Description: Halt condition.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Price 1
Field.Description: Default value is 0. SSR Triggering Trade Price or Indication Low Price depending on Security Status.

Field.Name: Price 2
Field.Description: Default value is 0. Indication High Price if securityStatus = G or I.

Field.Name: SSR Triggering Exchange ID
Field.Description: Only populated when securityStatus = A and this security is listed on this exchange. Otherwise defaulted to space (0x20).

Field.Name: SSR Triggering Volume
Field.Description: Default value is 0. Only populated when securityStatus = A and this security is listed on this exchange.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Default value is 0. Format: HHMMSSmmm. SSR Trigger Time if securityStatus = A.

Field.Name: SSRState
Field.Description: The current SSR state.

Field.Name: MarketState
Field.Description: The current Market State.

Field.Name: SessionState
Field.Description: Unused. Defaulted to 0x20.

Message.Name: Outright Series Index Mapping Message
Message.Description: Published over the real-time data channels at system startup or in the context of a refresh sequence. Provides referential data for a single specified options outright series.

Field.Name: Series Index
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series for all products within this market.

Field.Name: Series Type
Field.Description: Identifies series type.

Field.Name: Market ID
Field.Description: Identifies originating market.

Field.Name: System ID
Field.Description: ID of the originating matching engine server.

Field.Name: OptionSymbolRoot
Field.Description: Root symbol for options in OCC symbology (EX. BRKB)

Field.Name: UnderlyingSymbol
Field.Description: Underlying symbol for options in NYSE symbology (EX. BRK B)

Field.Name: UnderlyingIndex
Field.Description: Underlying stock mapping index

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: Price Scale Code for price conversion of the series. Default Series Price Scale Code is '4'

Field.Name: ContractMultiplier
Field.Description: Number of Underlying shares per option contract

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Option maturity date - YYMMDD

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: Put or Call indicator.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price. ASCII 0-9 with optional decimal point. EG:51.75, 123 (Option only)

Field.Name: ClosingOnlyIndicator
Field.Description: Closing Only Indicator.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Options Status Message
Message.Description: Informs clients of changes in the status of a specific option outright series and complex series, such as Trading Halts.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series within this market.

Field.Name: SeriesSeqNum
Field.Description: The unique ID of this message in the sequence of messages published for this specific series.

Field.Name: Series Status
Field.Description: The new status that this series is transitioning to.

Field.Name: Market State
Field.Description: Market Session value.

Field.Name: Options Status Halt Condition
Field.Description: Halt condition for option series.

Message.Name: Complex Series Index Mapping Message
Message.Description: Published over the real-time data channels at system startup or in the context of a refresh sequence. Provides referential data for a single specified options complex series.

Field.Name: Series Index
Field.Description: The unique ID of this Complex series within this market.

Field.Name: Market ID
Field.Description: Identifies originating market.

Field.Name: System ID
Field.Description: ID of the Originating matching engine server.

Field.Name: NoOfLegs
Field.Description: Number of legs in complex symbol. 2 - 12

Field.Name: Complex Series Index Mapping Leg
Field.Description: Repeating leg group

Message.Name: Retransmission Request Message
Message.Description: Sent by clients via TCP/IP to request retransmission of missed messages.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNum
Field.Description: The beginning sequence number of the range of messages to be retransmitted.

Field.Name: EndSeqNum
Field.Description: The end sequence number of the range of messages to be retransmitted.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client requesting this retransmission. All trailing characters should be NULL.

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the feed for which a retransmission is requested.

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel on which the gap occurred.

Message.Name: Refresh Header Message
Message.Description: The first message in each packet of refresh messages published over the Refresh multicast channels.

Field.Name: CurrentRefreshPkt
Field.Description: The current refresh packet in the update

Field.Name: TotalRefreshPkts
Field.Description: The total number of refresh packets you should expect in the update

Field.Name: LastSeqNum
Field.Description: The last sequence number sent on the channel for any symbol. The refresh is the state of the order book as of this sequence number.

Field.Name: LastSymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The last symbol sequence number sent for this symbol. The refresh is the symbol state as of this symbol sequence number.

Message.Name: Refresh Request Message
Message.Description: Sent by clients via TCP/IP to request a refresh of the state of one or all symbols in a specific channel.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol for which a refresh is requested. Set to 0 for all symbols in the channel.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client requesting this retransmission. All trailing characters should be NULL.

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the feed for which the refresh is requested.

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel for which the refresh is requested.

Message.Name: Symbol Index Mapping Request Message
Message.Description: Sent by clients via TCP/IP requesting the Symbol Index Mapping messages for one or all symbols in a specified channel.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol for which a refresh is requested. Set to 0 for all symbols in the channel.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client requesting this retransmission. All trailing characters should be NULL.

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the feed for which the refresh is requested.

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel for which the refresh is requested.

Field.Name: RetransmitMethod
Field.Description: The delivery method for the requested symbol index mapping information. 0 - deliver via UDP

Message.Name: Message Unavailable Message
Message.Description: Sent over the Retransmission multicast channels to inform clients of unavailability of a range of messages.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNum
Field.Description: The beginning sequence number of the unavailable range of messages.

Field.Name: EndSeqNum
Field.Description: The ending sequence number of the unavailable range of messages.

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the feed for which the retransmission was requested.

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel for which the retransmission was requested.

Message.Name: Request Response Message
Message.Description: Sent immediately via TCP/IP in response to the client's request for retransmission, refresh or Symbol Mapping messages.

Field.Name: RequestSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of the request message sent by the client.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNum
Field.Description: For Retrans Request responses, the beginning sequence number. For Refresh or Symbol Mapping Requests, 0.

Field.Name: EndSeqNum
Field.Description: For Retrans Request responses, the ending sequence number. For Refresh or Symbol Mapping Requests, 0.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client requesting this retransmission. All trailing characters should be NULL.

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the feed for which the request was made.

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel for which the request was made.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: The reason why the request was rejected.

Message.Name: Heartbeat Response Message
Message.Description: Clients who remain connected to the Retransmission Server intraday must respond to a Heartbeat with a Heartbeat Response message within 5 seconds.

Field.Name: SourceID
Field.Description: The ID of the client requesting this retransmission. All trailing characters should be NULL.

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: Series index if Security type is Option. Underlying index if Security type is Equity. This field will repeat for each leg.

Field.Name: Leg Ratio Qty
Field.Description: Leg Ratio. This field will repeat for each leg.

Field.Name: Leg Side
Field.Description: Leg side. This field will repeat for each leg.

Field.Name: Leg Security Type
Field.Description: Leg Security Type. This field will repeat for each leg.
